supported_claims: Under a frozen fair Bernoulli null and one-sided 4-bit exact p values, flexible unadjusted search across three independent blocks reports false positives with chance 721/4096, exceeding alpha 1/8.
A single fixed prespecified first block reports with exact probability 1/16 under all examined family sizes.
Bonferroni family precommitment prevents false positive inflation in this finite design; at family size 3, discreteness yields no possible rejections.
limitations: Pure mathematical design with no real preregistration submission or registered-report peer review.
Does not causally identify actual reporting behavior, publication bias or the effect of registration policies on social science.
No independent real human E2, historical E3, or outside-the-sample psychological forecasting evidence.
